mapper.select: SELECT a.apr01_appr_id AS appr_id , a.apr01_reg_emp_id AS reg_emp_id , a.apr01_status_cd AS status_code , a.apr01_class_tree_id AS class_tree_id , c.dcr01_advert_yn AS advert_yn FROM apr01_appr a LEFT JOIN dcr01_class_tree c ON c.dcr01_class_tree_id = a.apr01_class_tree_id WHERE a.apr01_appr_id = #{apprId} AND a.apr01_company_id = #{companyId}
SELECT dcr01_advert_yn FROM dcr01_class_tree WHERE dcr01_class_tree_id = #{classTreeId}

SELECT COALESCE(org02_dcr_id_word, null) FROM org02_info INNER JOIN org01_code ON org01_code_id = org02_code_id INNER JOIN sys01_company ON sys01_company_id = org01_company_id WHERE org02_code_id = CAST(f_get_emptrans(#{regEmpId}, CAST(#{regDate} AS date), 'org_code_id') AS NUMERIC) AND sys01_company_id = #{companyId} AND sys01_dcr_numbering_cd = '2' AND org02_mod_date = ( SELECT MAX(x.org02_mod_date) FROM org02_info x WHERE x.org02_code_id = CAST(f_get_emptrans(#{regEmpId}, CAST(#{regDate} AS date), 'org_code_id') AS NUMERIC) AND x.org02_mod_date <= #{regDate} )
SELECT emp60_sign_id FROM emp60_sign WHERE emp60_person_id = #{personId} AND COALESCE(emp60_use_yn, 'false') = 'true' LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO apr04_appr_step ( apr04_appr_step_id, apr04_appr_id, apr04_step_type_cd, apr04_seq, apr04_step_status_cd, apr04_step_emp_id , apr04_appr_emp_id, apr04_appr_date, apr04_note, apr04_lock_yn, apr04_add_emp_id, apr04_sign_id ) VALUES ( #{apprStepId}, #{apprId}, #{stepTypeCode}, #{seq}, #{stepStatusCode}, #{stepEmpId} , #{apprEmpId}, #{apprDate}, #{note}, #{lockYn}, #{addEmpId}, #{signId} )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys10_file WHERE sys10_parent_id = #{parentId}
SELECT sys10_file_id AS file_id , sys10_server_path AS server_path FROM sys10_file WHERE sys10_parent_id = #{parentId}
